insight.title: Quick insight
insight.stable: Conditions are fairly steady through the day, so pick the hour that suits you and your plans.
insight.waves.upSurf: Waves build later in the day, which may improve surfing. Aim for the later hours.
insight.waves.downSurf: The sea calms during the day. Surfers should use the earlier hours before the waves drop.
insight.waves.up: Waves build later in the day, so if you want more movement in the water, aim for later.
insight.waves.down: The sea calms later in the day, so for calm swimming or kids consider the later hours.
insight.waves.stable: Wave height stays fairly steady, so the decision depends more on wind and your activity.
insight.wind.upCalm: The wind picks up later, so for SUP or swimming with kids, come early while it's calm.
insight.wind.up: The wind is calmer now and builds later, so SUP and swimming with kids suit the earlier hours.
insight.wind.down: The wind eases later, so the later hours may be more comfortable for calm water activities.
insight.wind.shift: The wind direction changes during the day, so check the exact hour before surfing or sailing.
insight.wind.stable: The wind stays fairly steady, so choose an hour by wave height and temperature.
insight.air.hot: It's warming up and will get hot, so for a pleasant beach stay arrive before the peak heat.
insight.air.up: Temperatures rise gradually and it gets more pleasant later, good for sun lovers.
insight.air.stable: Temperature stays fairly steady, so pick an hour by wind and waves.
insight.air.down: It cools down later, so if you feel the cold, come earlier.
insight.water.stable: Water temperature is steady through the day, so it mostly depends on wind, waves and your preferred hour.
insight.water.changes: Water temperature changes a little during the day.
